---
title: Research
description: "Research and academic publications by Jon Marius Vaag Iversen on education economics, grading and assessment, labour economics and applied microeconometrics."
---

My research combines applied microeconometrics and education economics with an interest in labour markets, immigration and public policy.

## Current working papers

::: {.publication}
**Exams as Information: Exposure to Math Exams and Later Study Choices**  
Colin P. Green, Jon Marius Vaag Iversen, Lindsey Macmillan and Gill Wyness (2026).  
*Working paper.*  
Using random assignment to mathematics examinations in Norway, we examine how assessment information shapes students’ choices of advanced mathematics, subsequent STEM pathways and higher education outcomes.
:::

## Forthcoming book chapters and work in progress

::: {.publication}
**Grading and its consequences**  
Colin Green and Jon Marius Vaag Iversen (forthcoming, 2027).  
In *Handbook of Labor, Human Resources and Population Economics.*  
A review of the economics literature on grading, assessment and their consequences for educational and later-life outcomes.
:::

::: {.publication}
**Class size effects on educational outcomes**  
Colin Green and Jon Marius Vaag Iversen.  
Chapter in preparation for *The Economics of Education*, edited by Steve Bradley and Colin Green.  
A review of causal evidence on class size, empirical challenges and the mechanisms through which class size may affect student outcomes.
:::

## Research programme

My current research examines school assessment, grading practices, educational choices and their long-run consequences. I am particularly interested in the differences between teacher assessments and external examinations, and how these differences matter for educational opportunities. See [EduGAP](projects.qmd) for the wider research programme.

Additional publications and working papers: [NTNU research profile](https://www.ntnu.edu/employees/jon.iversen) · [Google Scholar (publication search)](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=author%3A%22Jon+Marius+Vaag+Iversen%22).
